title: Sleek East Nashville Getaway
description:
This stylish 3BR townhouse is located in East Nashville, a vibrant neighborhood within walking distance of a great selection of restaurants and entertainment. Beautiful newly constructed 3 storey townhouse that's just a few minutes away from Broadway!

The space
Enjoy your time in The Music City with your group of friends or family by spreading out in our spacious new-construction home.  Just moments from downtown, this home is the perfect place to get ready for your night out on Broadway, or to relax as a group while using our ample open-space social area and fully equipped kitchen. Wind down your day in our generous sleeping arrangements or cozy up on the couch to watch your favorite show. Our home is close to restaurants, nightlife, shopping, parks and much more.

Other features:
Washer and dryer 
Excellent wireless internet
Cable TV with Netflix
Memory foam mattresses
Extra pillows and blankets
Comfortable linens
Cotton bath towels
Hair dryers
Shampoo and body wash

Guest access
Guest access will be provided via a timed keypad lock that will begin at 4 PM the day off check-in and be cut off at 11 AM the day of check-out
